realm.name: bobcrew-admin
realm.description: May see, use, share and close every session on bob-crew servers

realm.name: bobcrew-cap-docker
realm.description: May start sessions with a Docker Engine of their own, where the server allows it (privileged containers: root on the Docker host)

realm.name: bobcrew-cap-libvirt
realm.description: May start sessions that run virtual machines, where the server allows it (privileged containers: root on the Docker host)

clients.name: bob-crew UI
clients.description: The bob-crew UI each user runs on their own machine: a public client with PKCE. A loopback redirect URI without a port matches any port (RFC 8252), so UIs on any port can log in.
